title: Litenova Frontend Design Contract
description: The metadata block opening the DESIGN.md at a React web frontend root. The block carries what a validator resolves; the sections under it carry what a reader and an agent compose from.

schemaVersion.$comment: Each release pins one exact shape. A consumer adopting a later release absorbs every difference at that moment, so no minor-compatible range exists between two releases. See standards/rule/core-authoring.publish-each-release-as-a-complete-contract and standards/rule/core-authoring.exclude-cross-release-compatibility-work.

package.description: The shared UI package this contract travels with.

profile.description: The density the contract's worked example is written at. A package serving several frontends states one.

patterns.$comment: The floorplans this frontend provides, by identifier. The vocabulary binds each one, and the Patterns section states when to use it.
